home.intro: Put names, teams or anything else into a pot, send the link, and everyone draws on their own phone. Results stay on each device.
home.hostedEmpty: You have not created a pot on this device yet.
home.historyEmpty: Draws you make show up here.
home.forgetMessage: This only removes it from this device. The pot itself stays online.

create.title: New draw pot
create.name: Name
create.entriesHint: One entry per line. "Name *3" puts it in three times.
create.namesHint: One name per line. Everyone picks their own name and draws someone else.
create.privacy: The pot is stored on the Nexumia server and deleted automatically after 60 days. Only the host link can change or delete it.

problem.title: Please give the pot a name.
problem.santaMin: Secret santa needs at least 2 names.
problem.santaDuplicates: Every name may appear only once in secret santa.

create.privacyCompanion: The pot is stored on your own Nexumia server and deleted automatically after 60 days. Only the host link can change or delete it.

settings.modePotHint: Participants draw entries at random from the pot.
settings.modeSantaHint: Everyone picks their own name and draws exactly one other person. Nobody draws themselves, and the assignment is fixed from the start, so the last person never gets stuck.
settings.removeDrawnOn: Each entry can be drawn only once until the pot is empty.
settings.removeDrawnOff: Entries go back into the pot and can be drawn again.
settings.multiDrawHint: Participants get a button to draw again.
settings.showEntriesHint: Participants see all entries and which ones are already gone.
settings.hostSeesResultsHint: Off: results stay secret, even from you. You only see how many have drawn.

admin.participantLinkHint: Send this link or let people scan the QR code.
admin.hostLinkHint: Opens this host view on another device. Anyone with it can reset or delete the pot.
admin.resultsHidden: Results are secret. You see only that someone drew.
admin.resetMessage: All draws are discarded and every entry goes back into the pot. Participants keep the old result in their local history.
admin.deleteMessage: The pot is deleted from the server. The link stops working; participants keep their local history.
admin.noKey: This device has no host access to this pot. Open the host link to manage it.
admin.forgetMessage: The pot is only removed from your list on this device. You can add it again later with the host link.

participant.whoAreYouHint: Pick your own name. Names already taken are greyed out.
participant.santaDone: Done! Keep it secret. Your result stays saved on this device.
participant.noDrawsLeft: You have used all your draws. Your results stay saved on this device.

errors.network: No connection to the draw server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.not_found: This pot does not exist or has expired.
errors.limit_reached: You have used all your draws.
errors.identity_taken: Someone has already picked this name. Choose your own name.
errors.forbidden: No host access to this pot.
errors.unavailable: The draw server is not available right now. Try again later.

storage.label: Where is the pot stored?
storage.cloudHint: Stored on the Nexumia server at Cloudflare. Works for everyone with the link.
storage.companionHint: Stored on your own server ({{url}}). Participants' devices talk to it directly.
storage.notPublic: This address only works in your own network (or without HTTPS). People elsewhere cannot open the pot. Use a public HTTPS address, e.g. the Cloudflare tunnel of your server.

groups.hint: Enter how many people take part and the largest group size. Balanced groups are added as entries (e.g. "Group 1 *4").
